DMSE LAB · 데이터 기반 소재 합성 및 공학 연구실

Data-driven Materials Synthesis
and Engineering.

We make nanoporous materials, measure them carefully, and let the data decide the next design. Six subjects, one loop: design, synthesis, applications, and AI-guided rediscovery.

All research ↗
01 · LEARNING

AI material design

Models trained on our own synthesis and performance data propose the next candidates; active learning chooses the experiment.

Read more →
02 · MAKING

Controlled synthesis

Sol–gel, hydrothermal and solvothermal routes to aerogels, alloys and oxides with controlled porosity and interfaces.

Read more →
03 · STRUCTURE

Nanoporous architecture

Pore geometry, connectivity and surface chemistry as design variables, quantified by physisorption, microscopy and XPS.

Read more →
04 · CAPTURE

Selective adsorption

Electrified CO₂ capture and molecular separation on interfaces where binding is switched by potential.

Read more →
05 · REACTION

Electrocatalysis

Hydrogen and oxygen evolution, ammonia oxidation and plasma-assisted electrochemistry on noble-metal-lean surfaces.

Read more →
06 · ENERGY

Electrochemical energy

Porous electrodes where ion transport and interfacial reactions meet: electrolyzers, supercapacitors, batteries.

Read more →
